name: how-to-kick-saas
description: The complete open-source book "How to Kick SaaS" by Jason M. Long, packaged as nine skills covering validation, costing, pricing, build, acquisition, activation, retention and growth, plus a local search CLI over all 126 chapters.
longDescription:
## What this is

This plugin bundles the full text of the open-source book **How to Kick SaaS** by **Jason M. Long** (JH Media Group) — *"SaaS business building: Ideation, Validation, Costing, Pricing, Development, Marketing, Sales, Support, Traction, and Growth."*

## What's inside

| Component | Detail |
|---|---|
| `book/` | All **126 chapters**, verbatim, in the book's own SUMMARY.md order, plus its **40 original diagram/image assets** |
| 9 skills | One navigation index + one working skill per book section |
| `kick-saas-search` CLI | Zero-dependency full-text search over every chapter |
| `saas-strategist` sub-agent | Applies the book's frameworks to a specific SaaS idea or problem |

## The nine skills

- **saas-book-index** — full chapter map, section routing, attribution rules
- **saas-business-foundations** — what a SaaS is, its parts, the end-to-end process
- **saas-validation** — proving demand, competition and buyer analysis before building
- **saas-build-process** — scoping, costing, team roles, tooling, development lifecycle
- **saas-pricing** — pricing metrics, models, psychology, the pricing page
- **saas-acquisition** — SEO, content, PPC, outbound, social, automation, partnerships
- **saas-activation** — onboarding and activation (the book's least complete section, marked as such)
- **saas-retention-community** — support, churn, community, chatbots
- **saas-growth-hacks** — the author's raw tactics, benchmarks and field notes

## A note on the source

The author states plainly in the book that **it is not finished**, and several sections are incomplete. This package preserves that state faithfully and marks every stub rather than filling the gaps. The book's last content commit was 2020, so time-sensitive figures (costs, tool pricing, ad platforms) should be treated as historical.

This is one practitioner's opinionated experience, not verified research.

Source: https://github.com/JH-Media-Group/how-to-kick-saas

subAgents.description: SaaS strategy specialist grounded in the How to Kick SaaS book. Dispatch for multi-stage work: validating a SaaS idea, sizing and costing a build, setting pricing, planning acquisition channels, diagnosing churn, or any task that needs the book's frameworks applied to a specific product with a written, citation-backed answer.
